test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six persons (L, M, N, O, P and Q) are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Q is sitting second to the right of N. P is sitting second to the left of M. Q is an immediate neighbour of L and P. L is sitting second to the right of M. Who is sitting third to the left of O?
solution:
**Given: **Six persons (L, M, N, O, P and Q) are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) L is sitting second to the right of M. 

2) P is sitting second to the left of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f957cbd62b3e689164cb8b2de11c6946a5d4153b486a542f49bc55180a18e62d.png] 

3) Q is an immediate neighbour of L and P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29ae4686c7f4603cb7be66b0f8f431035770bbfe6d8a9585d80eeaad0659caa1.png] 

4) Q is sitting second to the right of N. 

After positioning N only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69ef166dcc4f3f4c2943ad92739a3bbcaff409f810fcbaf3ba86843371274318.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, L is sitting third to the left of O.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
